careers.title: Farada Careers
careers.subtitle: Join our exceptional team and help us create an extraordinary coffee experience for our customers
careers.joinTeamDesc: At Farada, we believe our success depends on our exceptional team. We're looking for passionate and creative employees to join our journey in providing the best coffee experience for our customers.
careers.dynamicEnvironmentDesc: We provide a stimulating and innovative work environment that encourages creativity and growth
careers.developmentOpportunitiesDesc: Continuous training programs and opportunities for promotion and professional development
careers.competitiveBenefitsDesc: Generous salaries, health insurance, and paid leave
careers.inclusiveCultureDesc: We welcome diversity and believe in creating an inclusive work environment for everyone
careers.salesRepresentativeDesc: We're looking for a passionate sales representative to boost our sales and build strong relationships with customers.
careers.warehouseSupervisorDesc: We're looking for an organized warehouse supervisor to ensure effective inventory management and daily operations.
careers.webDeveloperDesc: We're looking for a talented web developer to improve our website and develop new applications.
careers.applyStep1: Send your CV with a cover letter to:
careers.applyStep2: Make sure to include the desired position in the email subject
careers.applyStep3: We'll review your application and contact you within 5-7 business days
careers.applyStep4: If selected, we'll arrange a personal or video interview
careers.tip1: • Make sure your CV is updated
careers.trainingDevelopmentDesc: We provide comprehensive training programs for all employees, including product training, customer service, and leadership skills. We believe in investing in our employees to ensure their success and company growth.
careers.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions about available positions or the application process, don't hesitate to contact us:
careers.joinUsDesc: Join the Farada team and help us create an exceptional coffee experience for our customers

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.subtitle: Discover Farada's story and our journey in providing the best coffee experience for our valued customers
whoWeAre.ourStoryDesc: Farada was established in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with the goal of providing the best types of coffee and high-quality products for our valued customers. We believe that coffee is not just a drink, but a unique experience that combines authenticity and modernity.
whoWeAre.ourVisionDesc: We strive to be the first choice for coffee lovers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the region, through providing high-quality products and exceptional customer service that makes every visit an unforgettable experience.
whoWeAre.ourMissionDesc: Providing the best types of coffee and carefully selected products, while maintaining the highest standards of quality and service. We are committed to providing a unique consumer experience worthy of our valued customers.
whoWeAre.qualityDesc: We choose the best products and ensure their high quality
whoWeAre.honestyDesc: We deal with our customers with complete honesty and transparency
whoWeAre.innovationDesc: We always strive to develop our services and provide new things
whoWeAre.ourExperienceDesc: We have years of experience in the coffee and high-quality products field. Our team of specialized experts ensures providing the best advice and products suitable for your needs.
whoWeAre.communityCommitmentDesc: We believe in the importance of social responsibility and participate in many community initiatives. We strive to build strong relationships with our local community and provide support for charitable and educational projects.
whoWeAre.ourFutureDesc: We plan to expand into new areas and provide more innovative products and services. Our goal is to be the trusted partner for coffee lovers throughout the Kingdom.
whoWeAre.joinUsCoffee: Join us on the coffee journey
whoWeAre.joinUsCoffeeDesc: Discover a world of distinctive flavors and exceptional service with Farada

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.subtitle: We're here to help you and answer all your questions. Our customer service team is always available to serve you
contactUs.subject: Subject
contactUs.weAreHereToHelpDesc: We strive to hear your inquiries and help you always. Our customer service team is available during working hours to answer all your questions.

terms.liabilityDesc: Farada shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages resulting from your use of the website.
terms.modificationsDesc: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on the website.
terms.governingLawDesc: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

saleTerms.title: Sale Terms & Conditions
saleTerms.subtitle: Terms and conditions governing the sale of products through our website
saleTerms.purchaseOrdersDesc: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. We reserve the right to refuse any order.
saleTerms.pricingPaymentDesc: All prices are in Saudi Riyals and include VAT. Payment must be made at the time of ordering.
saleTerms.orderConfirmationDesc: You will receive an email confirmation once your order has been processed and confirmed.
saleTerms.shippingDeliveryDesc: Delivery times vary by location. We will provide estimated delivery dates during checkout.
saleTerms.orderCancellationDesc: Orders can be cancelled within 24 hours of placement, subject to our cancellation policy.
saleTerms.warrantyDesc: All products come with manufacturer warranty. Please refer to individual product pages for warranty details.
saleTerms.privacySecurityDesc: We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring secure transactions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy.introductionDesc: This Privacy Policy explains how Farada collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.informationCollectedDesc: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us.
privacy.howWeUseDesc: We use the information we collect to process your orders, communicate with you, and improve our services.
privacy.informationSharingDesc: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to third parties without your consent.
privacy.informationProtectionDesc: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.cookiesDesc: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and analyze website traffic.
privacy.yourRightsDesc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time.
privacy.policyChangesDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page.
privacy.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: How we use cookies and similar technologies on our website
cookies.whatAreCookiesDesc: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit our website.
cookies.typesOfCookiesDesc: We use essential cookies for website functionality, analytics cookies to understand usage, and marketing cookies for personalized content.
cookies.howWeUseDesc: Cookies help us provide you with a better experience by remembering your preferences and analyzing website traffic.
cookies.thirdPartyCookiesDesc: Some cookies are placed by third-party services that appear on our pages, such as analytics and social media plugins.
cookies.cookieManagementDesc: You can control and manage cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling cookies may affect website functionality.
cookies.disablingCookiesDesc: Most browsers allow you to refuse cookies or delete them. Please refer to your browser's help section for instructions.
cookies.policyUpdatesDesc: We may update this Cookies Policy from time to time. Please check this page regularly for updates.
cookies.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions about our use of cookies, please contact us.
